entities.title: Visitor's visa for visiting friends and family in Germany
entities.summary: This page provides information on the requirements and process for applying for a visitor's visa to visit friends and family in Germany.
eligibility: The applicant must have a valid passport with at least three months' validity after the end of the desired visa.
The applicant must have health insurance that covers all Schengen countries with a minimum coverage of €30,000.
required_documents: Current passport and copies of all previous passports and visa
Confirmation of employment or university enrolment in Pakistan and NOC for the trip
FRC (Family Registration Certificate), Marriage Certificate (if applicable), and Birth Certificate (for minor applicants)
application_process: Fill out the Videx online application system and print out the signed original.
Submit the application with all required documents.
important_notes: The applicant must provide all required documents in the correct order and format.
The applicant must disclose all previous visa refusals.
